title: SENSE：基于语义嵌入导航与软门控评估的检索式推测解码
summary: 提出SENSE方法，通过将检索锚定在目标模型的隐藏状态上建立语义对齐，并利用软门控评估模块验证语义等价性，从而解决检索式推测解码中词汇依赖导致的鲁棒性问题。在LLaMA和Qwen系列模型上实现高达4.09的平均接受长度和3.26倍加速，同时保持生成质量。
summary_en: Proposes SENSE, which anchors retrieval on target model hidden states for semantic alignment and uses soft-gated evaluation for semantic equivalence validation, addressing robustness issues in retrieval-based speculative decoding. Achieves up to 4.09 mean acceptance length and 3.26x speedup on LLaMA and Qwen models while preserving generation quality.
